name: Art Goat
original_description: Art Goat is a search tool that helps visual artists find opportunities to apply for that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later: grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and juried exhibitions, awards, commissions, scholarships, workshops, art jobs and internships. Ask in plain language, for example "ceramics residencies in Europe", "photography grants closing this month", "funded residencies for a painter in New York" or "fellowships for emerging artists", and Art Goat returns matching listings with the deadline, the award or stipend amount on file (for commissions this is the total project budget covering all project costs, not take-home pay; a stipend may be a per-period rate with the period given on the listing), any fee amounts on file, the stored eligibility scope, and a link to the full listing on artgoat.com. Listings come from Art Goat's directory and are shown as filed there, refreshed about every minute; listings with a past deadline are excluded unless marked rolling or deadline to be announced. Art Goat is anonymous to use in ChatGPT (no account or sign-in) and never drafts or edits application materials. Always verify deadline, eligibility and fees on the listing page before applying.
